$comment: CONTRACT DATA, NOT A CONVENIENCE LIST.
Every production provider under Tesserafin.Providers that issues an outbound request is
declared here, whether or not it authenticates. The provider-authentication audit
(tests/Tesserafin.Providers.Tests/ProviderAuth) reads this file and the COMPILED
Tesserafin.Providers.dll and fails ./ci/run.sh when the two disagree.
This file contains NO credential values and must never contain one. Everything here is a
host, a parameter name, a type name or a behavioural statement.
Adding a provider, an outbound host, a string constant in provider code, or a reader of a
credential property REQUIRES an edit here. That is the point: the gate turns an invisible

providers.name: TheMovieDb
providers.authentication: api-key handed to the TMDbLib client constructor
providers.authBoundaryNote: The request URL is composed inside TMDbLib, not in this assembly, so there is no auth boundary literal to pin here. The credential never becomes a constant in Tesserafin.Providers.dll.
providers.missingKeyBehaviour: No TMDbClient is constructed; IsConfigured is false; every read path returns null or an empty result; no request is issued; one warning names the setting.

providers.name: TheAudioDB
providers.authentication: api-key as a URL path segment
providers.authBoundaryNote: The compiler folds ApiRoot + "/" into one literal. Nothing may follow the trailing slash in any string constant: the key is appended at run time from configuration.
providers.missingKeyBehaviour: No request is issued at all; artist and album lookups return an empty MetadataResult; image lookups return an empty list; one warning names the setting.

providers.name: OMDb
providers.authBoundaryNote: The compiler folds ApiRoot + "?apikey=" into one literal. Nothing may follow the '=' in any string constant: the key is appended at run time from configuration.
providers.missingKeyBehaviour: No request is issued at all; searches return an empty result set; metadata lookups return HasMetadata=false; image lookups return an empty list; one warning names the setting.

providers.name: MusicBrainz
providers.authentication: none — anonymous, identified only by a User-Agent
providers.missingKeyBehaviour: Not applicable — no credential exists. The provider works out of the box.

providers.name: ListenBrainz Labs
providers.configurationSource: plugin-configuration (base URL and rate limit only, no credential)
providers.missingKeyBehaviour: Not applicable — no credential exists. The provider works out of the box.

providers.name: Studio images
providers.missingKeyBehaviour: Not applicable — no credential exists. The provider works out of the box.

$comment: Every `const string` declared by a type in a provider plugin namespace, by declaring type
and field name. The audit fails on any const string not listed here — with no entropy and
no length threshold, because a six-character credential is indistinguishable from any other
six-character string by inspection. Adding a constant means adding a line here, in review.
